description:
Standard OTTL editors (set, delete_key, keep_keys, append, clear, delete_index,
        delete_matching_keys, keep_matching_keys, flatten, limit, merge_maps, stringify_all,
        truncate_all, replace_match, replace_all_matches, replace_pattern, replace_all_patterns)
        and converters (Concat, ConvertCase, Double, Int, IsBool, IsDouble, IsList, IsMap, IsMatch,
        IsString, Len, Split, String, Substring, Trim, TrimPrefix, TrimSuffix). Registered via
        ServiceLoader so the plain engine discovers them. The Quarkus recorder registers the same
        classes explicitly.
